decision_point: Only after the complete original fixed eight-seed cohort has been retained and assessed.

literature.qualification: Matching the reported100ps duration does not establish equilibrium of this different realized initial configuration and finite set of chains. Temperature stationarity alone does not establish structural/potential stationarity.

post_gate_production.independence: The two cohorts share seed histories; do not count them as16 independent chains or pool them without a separate justified analysis.
post_gate_production.original_production: Retain the entire original cohort separately, including failed preparation diagnostics. Never overwrite it or silently replace its estimate.
post_gate_production.requirement: All eight must finish the fixed500ps preparation budget and undergo the unchanged U/T/OH/HOH checks and the structural assessment whose uncertainty policy must be settled before long preparation begins. No automatic production launch.
post_gate_production.suggested_fixed_cohort: Same eight seed-chain identities,25x4ps NVE per seed at0.25fs; exact phase/RNG draw registered before launch.

purpose: Test additional liquid equilibration without selecting chains or tuning transport toward the paper.

Small Reference continuous-versus-split preparation trace at the exact refresh boundary, including one and only one Maxwell draw and the saved external RNG.
CPU raw checkpoint identity and force-cache bound check before the first new step.

source_checkpoint_selection.filename_is_not_sufficient: Verify manifest step/phase, config/seed, full chunk SHA256, model/integrator identity, checkpoint contract and external RNG.
source_checkpoint_selection.hash_receipt: Append all eight exact selected checkpoint hashes before any extension starts; some do not yet exist.
source_checkpoint_selection.restore: Same binary Context checkpoint plus redundant raw positions/half-step velocities/forces and canonical q,p checks under the frozen v2 CPU force-cache contract; retain external NumPy RNG.
source_checkpoint_selection.selection_rule: Exact original 100 ps canonical preparation checkpoint before any NVE momentum draw; never a chosen production endpoint.

stationarity.all_chain_summary: Equal weight for the eight chain-level differences and a Student-t95% interval with7 degrees of freedom; individual-chain failures remain visible and cannot cancel in the average.
stationarity.uncertainty_reporting: Fixed5/10/20 ps block estimates and autocorrelation diagnostics; these do not change endpoints or choose a good window. An unresolved slow correlation leaves eligibility unestablished.

structural_diagnostics.RDF_maximum_difference_role: descriptive only; not an adopted mandatory equilibrium pass gate
structural_diagnostics.RDF_uncertainty_design_status: must be specified and independently reviewed before any long extension or inspection of its liquid RDF data
structural_diagnostics.also_report: All fixed-window curves, block uncertainties, across-seed spread, OH and HOH distributions from1ps full-state checkpoints. No chain is dropped for a failed structural diagnostic.
structural_diagnostics.coordination_definition: Two times unordered OO pairs inside3.5angstrom divided by frames*N; radius is fixed, not fitted to the observed first minimum.
structural_diagnostics.histogram_range: 0 to half the fixed cubic box length
structural_diagnostics.normalization: Unordered OO pairs divided by frames*N*(N-1)/2*shell_volume/V; cubic minimum-image distances.
required_pre_adoption_review: Keep the complete fixed-window RDF curves for every seed; no choosing bins, windows, seeds or thresholds after seeing the results.
Specify fixed 5/10/20 ps block uncertainty and a justified simultaneous-uncertainty assessment before adopting a mandatory RDF equivalence gate.
A confidence interval containing zero, or failure to reject a change, must not be called equivalence. Insufficient precision is unresolved.
The per-seed coordination threshold of0.1 remains an unadopted proposal and must also be assessed with fixed-block uncertainty; no calibration to current diffusion.
